';
EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[4]="data:image/webp;base64,";
EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[9]="data:image/webp;base64,";
function renderMap(){let layer=$('stationLayer');layer.innerHTML=DEVICES.map(d=>`<button class="station" data-id="${d.id}" style="left:${d.x}px;top:${d.y}px" aria-label="${d.name}を調べる"><span class="number">${String(d.id).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span class="stIcon" aria-hidden="true">${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[d.id]?`<img class="equipment-photo" src="${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[d.id]}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="">`:EQUIPMENT_ART[d.id]}</span><span class="stName">${d.short}</span><span class="doneMark">✓</span></button>`).join('');layer.querySelectorAll('.station').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();let d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===+b.dataset.id);openMission(d.id)}));$('secretLayer').innerHTML=SECRETS.map(s=>`<button class="spark" data-secret="${s.id}" style="left:${s.x-29}px;top:${s.y-29}px" aria-label="光る古い本から秘密を調べる"><span class="v31-tome-art" aria-hidden="true"><img src="${V31_SECRET_BOOK_IMAGE}" alt=""><span class="v31-book-mark">秘</span></span></button>`).join('');$('secretLayer').querySelectorAll('.spark').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();let s=SECRETS.find(x=>x.id===+b.dataset.secret);if(!s)return;openSecretChallenge(s.id)}));updateHud()}
function updateHud(){$('countCompleted').textContent=state.completed.length;$('countCoins').textContent=coins();$('countSecrets').textContent=state.secrets.length;document.querySelectorAll('.station').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('done',state.completed.includes(+b.dataset.id)));document.querySelectorAll('.spark').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('got',state.secrets.includes(+b.dataset.secret)));$('continueGame').disabled=!hasSave}
let hasSave=read();
function positionPlayer(){if(mascotCursorSrc!==ASSETS[state.character]&&$('mascotCursorImage')){$('mascotCursorImage').src=ASSETS[state.character];mascotCursorSrc=ASSETS[state.character]}let p=$('player');p.style.left=state.px+'px';p.style.top=state.py+'px';$('playerImg').src=ASSETS[state.character];$('playerImg').alt=CHARS.find(c=>c.id===state.character)?.name||''}
let scale=1,cameraX=0,cameraY=0,showFullWorld=false;
function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v))}
function updateCamera(){const vp=$('mapViewport');if(!vp.clientWidth||!vp.clientHeight)return;const vw=vp.clientWidth,vh=vp.clientHeight;
 if(showFullWorld||vw>=930){scale=Math.min((vw-10)/W,(vh-10)/H);cameraX=(vw-W*scale)/2;cameraY=0}
 else{scale=Math.max(vw/W,vh/H,(vw<650?.69:.78));const minX=Math.min(0,vw-W*scale),minY=Math.min(0,vh-H*scale);cameraX=clamp(vw*.5-state.px*scale,minX,0);cameraY=clamp(vh*.5-state.py*scale,minY,0)}
 $('world').style.transform=`translate(${cameraX}px,${cameraY}px) scale(${scale})`}
function focusArea(x,y){showFullWorld=false;$('recenter').textContent='全体表示';state.px=x;state.py=y;updateCamera();save()}
// Touch drag pans the map; no duplicate walking sprite is created.
let panStart=null;
$('mapViewport').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.pointerType==='mouse')return;panStart={id:e.pointerId,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,cx:cameraX,cy:cameraY,moved:false};});
$('mapViewport').addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!panStart||e.pointerId!==panStart.id)return;const dx=e.clientX-panStart.x,dy=e.clientY-panStart.y;if(Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)>12)panStart.moved=true;if(!panStart.moved)return;
 const vp=$('mapViewport'),vw=vp.clientWidth,vh=vp.clientHeight;
 cameraX=clamp(panStart.cx+dx,Math.min(0,vw-W*scale),Math.max(0,(vw-W*scale)/2));
 cameraY=clamp(panStart.cy+dy,Math.min(0,vh-H*scale),Math.max(0,(vh-H*scale)/2));
 $('world').style.transform=`translate(${cameraX}px,${cameraY}px) scale(${scale})`;});
function endPan(e){if(!panStart||e.pointerId!==panStart.id)return;const p=panStart;panStart=null;if(p.moved){const vp=$('mapViewport');state.px=clamp((vp.clientWidth/2-cameraX)/scale,28,W-28);state.py=clamp((vp.clientHeight/2-cameraY)/scale,28,H-28);save();}}
$('mapViewport').addEventListener('pointerup',endPan);$('mapViewport').addEventListener('pointercancel',endPan);
// Equipment is treated as an obstacle, so tap-to-walk routes around the cards.
function blocked(x,y){return x<28||y<27||x>W-26||y>H-27||DEVICES.some(d=>Math.abs(x-d.x)<82&&Math.abs(y-d.y)<76)}
function getRoute(sx,sy,tx,ty){const cell=27,cols=Math.floor(W/cell),rows=Math.floor(H/cell),gx=x=>clamp(Math.floor(x/cell),1,cols-2),gy=y=>clamp(Math.floor(y/cell),1,rows-2);let a=gx(sx)+gy(sy)*cols,b=gx(tx)+gy(ty)*cols,seen=new Int32Array(cols*rows).fill(-1),queue=new Int32Array(cols*rows),h=0,t=0;queue[t++]=a;seen[a]=a;let moves=[1,-1,cols,-cols];while(h<t){let v=queue[h++];if(v===b)break;let vx=v%cols,vy=Math.floor(v/cols);for(let m of moves){let n=v+m,nx=n%cols,ny=Math.floor(n/cols);if(n<0||n>=cols*rows||Math.abs(nx-vx)+Math.abs(ny-vy)!==1||seen[n]!==-1)continue;if(n!==b&&blocked((nx+.5)*cell,(ny+.5)*cell))continue;seen[n]=v;queue[t++]=n;}}if(seen[b]===-1)return[{x:tx,y:ty}];let p=[],cur=b;while(cur!==a&&p.length<cols*rows){p.push({x:((cur%cols)+.5)*cell,y:(Math.floor(cur/cols)+.5)*cell});cur=seen[cur]};p.reverse();p.push({x:tx,y:ty});return p}
function walkTo(x,y,onDone){focusArea(x,y);if(onDone)onDone()}
// In the exploration map, the selected mascot is the mouse pointer. Touch screens keep their normal controls.
const mascotCursor=$('mascotCursor');let mascotCursorSrc='';
function hideMascotCursor(){mascotCursor.classList.remove('visible')}
function moveMascotCursor(e){if(!running||e.pointerType!=='mouse'||$('modalWrap').classList.contains('open')){hideMascotCursor();return}
 const desired=ASSETS[state.character];if(mascotCursorSrc!==desired){$('mascotCursorImage').src=desired;mascotCursorSrc=desired}
 mascotCursor.style.left=e.clientX+'px';mascotCursor.style.top=e.clientY+'px';mascotCursor.classList.add('visible')}
$('mapViewport').addEventListener('pointermove',moveMascotCursor);
$('mapViewport').addEventListener('pointerleave',hideMascotCursor);
$('mapViewport').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.pointerType==='mouse'){mascotCursor.classList.remove('clicking');void mascotCursor.offsetWidth;mascotCursor.classList.add('clicking')}});
window.addEventListener('blur',hideMascotCursor);
$('mapViewport').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!e.target.closest('button')){ /* Empty floor does not move a duplicate character. */ }});
function syncModalFooter(){const foot=$('modalFooter'),body=$('modalBody');foot.replaceChildren();const actions=body.querySelector('.modalActions');if(actions)foot.appendChild(actions);foot.hidden=!actions}
function openModal(kind,title,body){$('modalWrap').classList.toggle('starMode',kind==='guide');hideMascotCursor();$('toast').classList.remove('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);lastFocus=document.activeElement;modalKind=kind;$('modalTitle').textContent=title; if(title.includes('スチームコンベクションオーブン')){$('modalTitle').innerHTML=title.replace('コンベクションオーブン','コンベクション<wbr>オーブン')}$('modalBody').innerHTML=body;syncModalFooter();$('modalWrap').classList.add('open');$('closeModal').focus()}
function closeModal(){$('modalWrap').classList.remove('open','starMode');modalKind='';phase='intro';if(lastFocus&&typeof lastFocus.focus==='function')lastFocus.focus()}
$('closeModal').addEventListener('click',closeModal);$('modalWrap').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===$('modalWrap'))closeModal()});window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&$('modalWrap').classList.contains('open'))closeModal()});

function openMission(id){activeId=id;phase='intro';let d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id);let done=state.completed.includes(id);let zoning=(({1:['その他の区域','前室'],2:['汚染作業区域','下処理室'],3:['汚染作業区域','食品保管室'],4:['非汚染作業区域','調理室・切裁'],5:['非汚染作業区域','調理室'],6:['非汚染作業区域','調理室'],7:['非汚染作業区域','調理室'],8:['非汚染作業区域','調理室'],9:['使用状況で区分','洗浄室'],10:['非汚染作業区域','洗浄後・保管'],11:['汚染作業区域','下処理室'],12:['非汚染作業区域','調理室']})[id]);let photo=EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[id]?`<img class="missionDevicePreview" src="${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[id]}" alt="${d.name}の設備イラスト">`:``;openModal('mission',`MISSION ${String(id).padStart(2,'0')} ／ ${d.name}`,`<span class="missionIcon">${d.icon}</span><p class="missionZone">🚪 ${zoning[1]} ／ ${zoning[0]}</p><p class="desc">${d.desc}</p>${photo}<div class="challengeCard"><p class="challengeQuestion">${done?'もういちど チャレンジできるよ！':'せつびの ひみつを みつけよう！'}</p><p class="hint">ゲームは設備のしくみを知るための疑似体験だよ。</p></div><div class="modalActions"><button class="mainBtn" id="startMission">✨ ミッション スタート！</button></div>`);$('startMission').onclick=()=>beginMission()}
function shuffle(arr){let c=[...arr];for(let i=c.length-1;i>0;i--){let j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[c[i],c[j]]=[c[j],c[i]]}return c}
function beginMission(){let d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===activeId);phase='challenge';sequenceIndex=0;tapCount=0;pairIndex=0;choices=shuffle(d.steps||[]);if(d.id===1){tapCount=0;}renderChallenge()}
function renderChallenge(){let d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===activeId),html=`<span class="missionIcon">${d.icon}</span>`;if(d.id===1){html+=`<div class="challengeCard"><p class="challengeQuestion">あわあわ てあらいゲーム！</p><p class="hint">ボタンを タップして てを きれいにしよう。100%で クリア！</p><div class="bar"><div style="width:${tapCount}%"></div></div><p class="stepProgress">きれいど ${tapCount}% / 100%</p><button class="tapButton" id="washHandsBtn" aria-label="てあらいゲーム">🫧</button><p class="hint">しっかり あわだてて、100%に なったら クリアだよ！</p></div>`;}else{html+=`<div class="challengeCard"><p class="challengeQuestion">${d.question}</p>`;if(d.type==='quiz'){html+=`<div class="options">${d.options.map((v,i)=>`<button class="option" data-quiz="${i}">${v}</button>`).join('')}</div>`}if(d.type==='sequence'){html+=`<p class="stepProgress">${sequenceIndex+1} / ${d.steps.length} ばんめを えらんでね</p><div class="options">${choices.map((v,i)=>`<button class="option ${d.steps.indexOf(v)<sequenceIndex?'used':''}" data-seq="${i}" ${d.steps.indexOf(v)<sequenceIndex?'disabled':''}>${v}</button>`).join('')}</div>`}if(d.type==='tap'){html+=`<div class="bar"><div style="width:${Math.round(100*tapCount/d.target)}%"></div></div><p class="stepProgress">${tapCount} / ${d.target} かい</p><button class="tapButton" id="tapMission" aria-label="${d.verb}">${d.id===8?'🥄':'💦'}</button><p class="hint">${d.verb}　ボタンを タップ！</p>`}if(d.type==='pair'){html+=`<p class="stepProgress">${pairIndex+1} / ${d.pairs.length} もん</p><p class="challengeQuestion">${d.pairs[pairIndex].q}</p><div class="options">${d.choices.map((v,i)=>`<button class="option" data-pair="${i}">${v}</button>`).join('')}</div>`}html+='</div>';}html+='<div id="challengeFeedback" class="feedback" aria-live="polite"></div>';html+=`<div class="modalActions"><button class="altBtn" id="backIntro">← せつびの せつめい</button></div>`;$('modalBody').innerHTML=html;syncModalFooter();$('backIntro').onclick=()=>openMission(activeId);if(d.id===1){$('washHandsBtn').onclick=()=>{tapCount=Math.min(100,tapCount+10);if(tapCount>=100)winMission();else renderChallenge()};return;}if(d.type==='quiz')document.querySelectorAll('[data-quiz]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(+b.dataset.quiz===d.correct)winMission();else wrong('もういちど かんがえてみよう！')});if(d.type==='sequence')document.querySelectorAll('[data-seq]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(choices[+b.dataset.seq]===d.steps[sequenceIndex]){sequenceIndex++;if(sequenceIndex===d.steps.length)winMission();else renderChallenge()}else wrong('じゅんばんが ちがうみたい。もういちど！')});if(d.type==='tap')$('tapMission').onclick=()=>{tapCount++;if(tapCount>=d.target)winMission();else renderChallenge()};if(d.type==='pair')document.querySelectorAll('[data-pair]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(d.choices[+b.dataset.pair]===d.pairs[pairIndex].a){pairIndex++;if(pairIndex>=d.pairs.length)winMission();else renderChallenge()}else wrong('ちがうみたい。もういちど えらんでね！')})}
function wrong(t){$('challengeFeedback').textContent=t;showToast('🔎 ヒントを みて もういちど！')}
function winMission(){let d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===activeId);let fresh=!state.completed.includes(activeId);if(fresh){state.completed.push(activeId);recentStarId=activeId;}state.bonus=state.completed.length===12;save();updateHud();phase='won';let last=state.completed.length===12;let prize=fresh?'🪙 +10 コイン！':'🌟 クリアずみの せつびだよ';let starCardReward=fresh?`<div class="starNewCard" role="status">${starCardArt(d)}<div><strong>★ スターカード GET！</strong>No.${String(d.id).padStart(2,'0')} ${d.name}<br>カードファイルに ほぞんしたよ！</div></div>`:'';if(last&&fresh)prize+=' ＋ ぜんぶクリアボーナス 20コイン！';$('modalBody').innerHTML=`<div class="stamp">🏅</div><h2 class="successTitle">ミッション クリア！</h2><p class="desc">「${d.name}」の ひみつを はっけん！<br>${d.desc}</p><div class="reward">${prize}</div>${starCardReward}<p class="hint">いまの ぼうけんは ほぞんされたよ。</p><div class="modalActions"><button class="mainBtn" id="doneMission">${last?'🎉 エンディングへ！':'🗺️ マップにもどる'}</button><button class="altBtn" id="missionGuide">⭐ カードファイル</button></div>`;syncModalFooter();burst();if(fresh)requestAnimationFrame(()=>launchCardCapture(d));$('doneMission').onclick=()=>{closeModal();if(last)showEnding();else showToast('✨ つぎの せつびを さがそう！')};$('missionGuide').onclick=()=>openGuide()}
function dismissCardCapture(){clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer);clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer2);const el=$('cardCaptureOverlay');el.classList.remove('visible','animate','collected');el.replaceChildren();}
function launchCardCapture(d){
 const host=$('cardCaptureOverlay');host.innerHTML=`<div class="cardCaptureSpark">✦　★　✧</div><div class="cardCaptureFront">${starCardArt(d)}</div><div class="cardCaptureLabel">★ スターカード GET！</div><div class="cardCaptureFolder"><b>📕</b><span>カードファイルに しゅうのう！</span></div>`;
 host.classList.remove('animate','collected');host.classList.add('visible');void host.offsetWidth;
 requestAnimationFrame(()=>host.classList.add('animate'));
 clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer);clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer2);window._cardEffectTimer=setTimeout(()=>{host.classList.add('collected');},880);
 window._cardEffectTimer2=setTimeout(()=>{host.classList.remove('visible','animate','collected');host.replaceChildren();},2050);
}
function burst(){for(let i=0;i<24;i++){let b=document.createElement('i');b.className='confetti';b.style.left=Math.round(Math.random()*100)+'vw';b.style.background=['#ffbc58','#ff80a6','#6fc3da','#80cf8b'][i%4];b.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*400-200)+'px');b.style.setProperty('--rot',(Math.random()*720-360)+'deg');b.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*.25)+'s';document.body.appendChild(b);setTimeout(()=>b.remove(),2200)}}
let starMobilePage=0,recentStarId=0;
function starCardArt(d){return `<img class="originalStarCard" src="${STAR_CARD_IMAGES[d.id]}" alt="${d.name} のオリジナルスターカード" loading="lazy" decoding="async">`}
function buildStarPocket(index){
 let d=DEVICES[index];
 if(!d)return `<div class="starPocket cardEmpty" aria-hidden="true"><span class="starEmptyLabel">✧ あきポケット</span></div>`;
 const got=state.completed.includes(d.id);
 if(!got)return `<div class="starPocket cardLocked" aria-label="No.${String(d.id).padStart(2,'0')} 未獲得"><span class="starLock">✧</span><span class="starNumber">No.${String(d.id).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span class="starEmptyLabel">みはっけん</span></div>`;
 const displayName={1:"手洗いシンク",2:"三層シンク",3:"冷蔵庫",4:"スライサー",5:"IHヒーター",6:"炊飯器",7:"スチコン",8:"回転釜",9:"食器洗浄機",10:"消毒保管庫"}[d.id];
 return `<button type="button" class="starPocket cardUnlocked ${recentStarId===d.id?'justCollected':''}" data-star-card="${d.id}" aria-label="獲得済みスターカード ${d.name}をくわしく見る"><span class="starCardFace"><span class="starCardVisual">${starCardArt(d)}</span></span></button>`;
}
function starFilePages(){
 // Existing 10 device cards occupy No.01-10. Empty sleeves are not additional invented cards.
 return [0,1].map(page=>`<section class="starSleevePage ${page!==starMobilePage?'starHiddenMobile':''}" aria-label="${page+1}ページ"><div class="starPageLabel">★ STAR CARDS <span>PAGE ${String(page+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span></div><div class="starPocketGrid">${Array.from({length:9},(_,j)=>buildStarPocket(page*9+j)).join('')}</div></section>`).join('');
}
function openGuide(){
 dismissCardCapture();
 const collected=state.completed.length;
 if(recentStarId){starMobilePage=recentStarId>9?1:0;}
 openModal('guide',`⭐ スターカードファイル　${collected} / ${DEVICES.length}`,`<div class="starAlbum"><div class="starAlbumBar"><div class="starMeter"><b>★ ${collected} / ${DEVICES.length} 枚</b><span class="starBar" aria-hidden="true"><i style="width:${collected/DEVICES.length*100}%"></i></span></div><span class="starAlbumHint">ミッションをクリアして カードをあつめよう！</span></div><div class="starBinder" id="starBinder"><div class="starSpread" id="starSpread">${starFilePages()}</div><div class="starBinderRings" aria-hidden="true"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div><div class="starPreview" id="starPreview" aria-live="polite"></div></div><div class="starBottomBar"><span>✨ ひみつ ${state.secrets.length} / 4</span><div class="starPagesNav"><button type="button" class="starPageBtn" id="starPrev" aria-label="前のページ">❮</button><span id="starPageLabel">${starMobilePage+1} / 2</span><button type="button" class="starPageBtn" id="starNext" aria-label="次のページ">❯</button></div><span>★ STAR CARD FILE</span></div></div><div class="modalActions"><button type="button" class="altBtn" id="guideClose">🗺️ マップにもどる</button></div>`);
 $('guideClose').onclick=closeModal;
 function updatePages(){
  $('starSpread').innerHTML=starFilePages();
  $('starPageLabel').textContent=starMobilePage+1+' / 2';
  $('starPrev').disabled=starMobilePage===0;
  $('starNext').disabled=starMobilePage===1;
  $('starSpread').querySelectorAll('[data-star-card]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>showStarDetail(Number(b.dataset.starCard)));
  const newest=recentStarId?$('starSpread').querySelector(`[data-star-card="${recentStarId}"]`):null;
  if(newest){newest.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',inline:'nearest'});}
 }
 $('starPrev').onclick=()=>{starMobilePage=0;updatePages()};
 $('starNext').onclick=()=>{starMobilePage=1;updatePages()};
 updatePages();
}
function showStarDetail(id){
 let d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!d||!state.completed.includes(id))return;
 const overlay=$('starPreview');
 overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="starPreviewCard" role="dialog" aria-label="${d.name} のスターカード"><span class="starPreviewNumber">★ STAR CARD No.${String(d.id).padStart(2,'0')}</span>${starCardArt(d)}<h3>${d.name}</h3><p>${d.desc}</p><button type="button" id="starDetailClose">ファイルにもどる</button></div>`;
 overlay.classList.add('active');
 $('starDetailClose').onclick=()=>{overlay.classList.remove('active');overlay.innerHTML='';};
 $('starDetailClose').focus();
}

function openHelp(){openModal('help','❔ あそびかた',`<div class="challengeCard"><p class="challengeQuestion">きゅうしょくしつを たんけんしよう！</p><p class="desc" style="text-align:left">① せつびをタップ／クリックして しらべよう<br>② スマホではスワイプして ほかのエリアも みよう<br>③ 12この ミッションを クリア！<br>④ かくされた ✦ も みつけてみよう<br>⑤ とちゅうでも セーブできるよ<br>⑥ せつびをクリアすると スターカードがたまるよ</p></div><div class="challengeCard"><p class="challengeQuestion">🪙 コインについて</p><p class="desc">はじめてのクリアで 10コイン、12こクリアで 20コインの ボーナス！<br>※ 現在はこのゲーム内の記録です。ふじのえランドのガチャとはまだ共通化していません。</p></div><p class="hint">実際の給食室では、区域ごとの衛生管理のルールを守って作業します。くわしくは「🚪 へやの区分」を見てね。</p><button class="altBtn" id="helpClose">わかった！</button>`);$('helpClose').onclick=closeModal}

const SANITARY_ROOMS=[
 {id:'entry',title:'🚪 前室',kind:'その他の区域',desc:'着がえや手あらいなど、作業に入る前のじゅんびをする場所。このゲームでは手洗いシンクを前室に置いているよ。',className:'other'},
 {id:'prep',title:'🥬 下処理室',kind:'汚染作業区域',desc:'野菜などをえらび、皮をむき、あらう場所。土などを調理室に持ちこまないために分けているよ。',className:'dirty'},
 {id:'storage',title:'🧊 食品保管室',kind:'汚染作業区域',desc:'受けとった食ざいを、ふさわしい温度や方法でほかんする場所だよ。',className:'dirty'},
 {id:'cut',title:'🔪 調理室・切裁',kind:'非汚染作業区域',desc:'下処理が終わった食品を切るなど、調理を進める場所だよ。',className:'clean'},
 {id:'cook',title:'🍲 調理室',kind:'非汚染作業区域',desc:'にる、焼く、むすなどの加熱や、料理を食かんに分ける場所だよ。',className:'clean'},
 {id:'dish',title:'🫧 洗浄室',kind:'使用状況で区分',desc:'食器などを洗う部屋は特別。洗浄・消毒前は汚染作業区域、洗浄・消毒後は非汚染作業区域としてあつかうよ。使い方で区分が変わるんだ。',className:'switch'},
 {id:'cupboard',title:'✨ 洗浄後・保管',kind:'非汚染作業区域',desc:'洗って消毒した食器や器具を、再びよごさないように保つ場所をイメージしているよ。',className:'clean'}
];
function openSanitaryRooms(focusId){
 const cards=SANITARY_ROOMS.filter(r=>!focusId||focusId===r.id).map(r=>`<div class="sanitaryGuideItem ${r.className}"><div><b>${r.title}</b><span>${r.kind}</span></div><p>${r.desc}</p></div>`).join('');
 openModal('sanitary','🚪 給食室の へやの区分',`<p class="sanitaryIntro">学校給食室では、食べものが よごれないように、する仕事にあわせて へやを分けるよ。ピンク・オレンジ系は食材の受入れや下処理、緑系は調理、紫系は洗浄室など、色を変えて見分けやすくしているよ。</p><div class="sanitaryLegend"><span class="sLeg dirty">汚染作業区域</span><span class="sLeg clean">非汚染作業区域</span><span class="sLeg other">その他の区域</span><span class="sLeg switch">洗浄室は使い方で区分</span></div><div class="sanitaryGuideGrid">${cards}</div><p class="sanitarySafety">※ この地図は学習用のモデル。実際の給食室の配置や出入口の管理は施設によって異なり、だれでも自由に区域を行き来できるわけではありません。洗浄室は使用状況に応じて区分します。</p><a class="detailLink" href="https://www.mext.go.jp/b_menu/hakusho/nc/__icsFiles/afieldfile/2009/09/10/1283821_1.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">文部科学省「学校給食衛生管理基準」を見る ↗</a><div class="modalActions"><button class="mainBtn" id="sanitaryClose">🗺️ たんけんにもどる</button></div>`);
 $('sanitaryClose').onclick=closeModal;
}

 ['給食室','きゅうしょくしつ'],['給食','きゅうしょく'],['設備','せつび'],['秘密','ひみつ'],['探索','たんさく'],['冒険','ぼうけん'],
 ['手洗い','てあらい'],['身支度','みじたく'],['前室','ぜんしつ'],['下処理室','したしょりしつ'],['食材','しょくざい'],['洗浄','せんじょう'],['食品保管室','しょくひんほかんしつ'],
 ['調理室・切裁','ちょうりしつ・せっさい'],['調理室','ちょうりしつ'],['切裁','せっさい'],['回転釜','かいてんがま'],['三層シンク','さんそうシンク'],['冷蔵庫','れいぞうこ'],
 ['食器洗浄機','しょっきせんじょうき'],['食器消毒保管庫','しょっきしょうどくほかんこ'],['消毒保管庫','しょうどくほかんこ'],['スチームコンベクションオーブン','スチームコンベクションオーブン'],
 ['立体自動炊飯器','りったいじどうすいはんき'],['炊飯器','すいはんき'],['非汚染作業区域','ひおせんさぎょうくいき'],['汚染作業区域','おせんさぎょうくいき'],['その他の区域','そのほかのくいき'],
 ['使い方で区分','つかいかたでくぶん'],['保管','ほかん'],['学校給食衛生管理基準','がっこうきゅうしょくえいせいかんりきじゅん'],['漢字','かんじ'],['戻る','もどる'],['保存','ほぞん']
];
function tx(str){
 if(state.reading!=='kana' || !str) return str;
 let out = String(str);
 KANA_MAP.forEach(([a,b])=>{ out = out.split(a).join(b); });
 return out;
}
function dName(d){ return tx(d.name.replace(/<wbr>/g,'')); }
function dShort(d){ return tx((d.short||d.name).replace(/<wbr>/g,'<wbr>')); }
function setButtonText(id, kanji, kana){ const el=$(id); if(el) el.textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? kana : kanji; }
function applyReadingMode(){
 document.documentElement.lang='ja';
 setButtonText('toggleReading', state.reading==='kana' ? '漢字に切替' : 'ひらがなに切替', state.reading==='kana' ? 'かんじにきりかえ' : 'ひらがなにきりかえ');
 setButtonText('returnTitle','タイトルに戻る','タイトルにもどる');
 setButtonText('openGuide','カードファイル','カードファイル');
 setButtonText('saveGame','保存','ほぞん');
 setButtonText('recenter', showFullWorld ? 'ズーム表示' : '全体表示', showFullWorld ? 'ズームひょうじ' : 'ぜんたいひょうじ');
 setButtonText('rechoose','キャラ変更','キャラへんこう');
 setButtonText('zonesGuide','部屋の区分','へやのくぶん');
 setButtonText('mapHelp','遊び方','あそびかた');
 const hint = document.querySelector('.gameToolbar .hint');
 if(hint) hint.textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? 'せつびをタップして ミニゲームに ちょうせん！' : '設備をタップしてミニゲームに挑戦！';
 const areaBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.areaNav button');
 const areaText = state.reading==='kana' ? ['えいせい','じゅんび','ちょうり','かたづけ'] : ['衛生','準備','調理','片付け'];
 areaBtns.forEach((b,i)=>{ b.textContent = areaText[i] || b.textContent; });
 const bottomTitle = document.querySelector('.heroFoot .hint');
 if(bottomTitle) bottomTitle.innerHTML = state.reading==='kana' ? '12この せつびを たんけんして、カードファイルを いっぱいに しよう！' : '12個の設備を探検して、カードファイルをいっぱいにしよう！';
 const chooseH = document.querySelector('#choose .bigHeading'); if(chooseH) chooseH.textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? 'だれと たんけんする？' : 'だれと探検する？';
 const chooseSub = document.querySelector('#choose .subHeading'); if(chooseSub) chooseSub.textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? 'すきな なかまを えらんでね。いつでも へんこうできるよ！' : '好きな仲間を選んでね。いつでも変更できるよ！';
 const launchTitle = document.querySelector('#launch h1'); if(launchTitle) launchTitle.innerHTML = state.reading==='kana' ? 'きゅうしょくしつの ひみつを<br class="compactBreak"> さがしにいこう！' : '給食室のひみつを<br class="compactBreak"> さがしに行こう！';
 const launchP = document.querySelector('#launch .launchHead p'); if(launchP) launchP.textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? 'せつめいを よんだら、すぐに スタート！' : '説明を読んだら、すぐにスタート！';
 const launchRules = document.querySelectorAll('#launch .launchRules span');
 if(launchRules[0]) launchRules[0].textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? 'せつびを タップして しらべよう' : '設備をタップして調べよう';
 if(launchRules[1]) launchRules[1].textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? 'クリアすると スターカードを ゲット！' : 'クリアするとスターカードをゲット！';
 if(launchRules[2]) launchRules[2].textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? 'とちゅうで ほぞんも できるよ' : '途中で保存もできるよ';
 Object.entries(ROOM_COPY).forEach(([key,val])=>{
   const room = document.querySelector(`.sanRoom[data-room="${key}"]`);
   if(!room) return;
   const title = room.querySelector('.roomTitle'); const kind = room.querySelector('.roomKind'); const floor = room.querySelector('.roomFloor');
   if(title) title.childNodes[0].nodeValue = (state.reading==='kana' ? tx(val.title) : val.title);
   if(kind) kind.textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? tx(val.kind) : val.kind;
   if(floor) floor.textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? tx(val.floor) : val.floor;
 });
 renderChoices(); renderMap(); updateHud();
}

Object.assign(DEVICES[9],{short:'消毒保管庫',question:'消毒保管庫の役割はどれ？',options:['洗った食器を消毒・保管する','米を炊く','肉を切る'],correct:0});
const originalCloseModal = closeModal;
closeModal = function(){ cleanupMiniGame(); originalCloseModal(); };
function cleanupMiniGame(){ if(timingRAF) cancelAnimationFrame(timingRAF); timingRAF = 0; timingState = null; bugState = null; }
function renderChoices(){
 ensureChar();
 const labelSelect = state.reading==='kana' ? 'えらんだよ' : '選択中';
 const labelTap = state.reading==='kana' ? 'タップして えらぶ' : 'タップして選ぶ';
 $('choiceGrid').innerHTML = CHARS.map(c=>`<button class="characterCard ${state.character===c.id?'selected':''}" data-char="${c.id}" aria-pressed="${state.character===c.id}"><img src="${ASSETS[c.id]}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="${c.name}"><strong>${c.name}</strong><span class="selectedTag">${state.character===c.id?'✓ '+labelSelect:labelTap}</span></button>`).join('');
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-char]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.character=b.dataset.char;save();renderChoices()}));
}
function renderMap(){
 let layer=$('stationLayer');
 layer.innerHTML=DEVICES.map(d=>`<button class="station" data-id="${d.id}" style="left:${d.x}px;top:${d.y}px" aria-label="${dName(d)}を調べる"><span class="number">${String(d.id).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span class="stIcon" aria-hidden="true">${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[d.id]?`<img class="equipment-photo" src="${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[d.id]}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="">`:EQUIPMENT_ART[d.id]}</span><span class="stName">${dShort(d)}</span><span class="doneMark">✓</span></button>`).join('');
 layer.querySelectorAll('.station').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();openMission(+b.dataset.id)}));
 $('secretLayer').innerHTML=SECRETS.map(s=>`<button class="spark" data-secret="${s.id}" style="left:${s.x-29}px;top:${s.y-29}px" aria-label="光る古い本から秘密を調べる"><span class="v31-tome-art" aria-hidden="true"><img src="${V31_SECRET_BOOK_IMAGE}" alt=""><span class="v31-book-mark">秘</span></span></button>`).join('');
 $('secretLayer').querySelectorAll('.spark').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();let s=SECRETS.find(x=>x.id===+b.dataset.secret);if(!state.secrets.includes(s.id)){state.secrets.push(s.id);save();updateHud();showToast(state.reading==='kana'?`「${tx(s.label)}」を みつけたよ！`:`「${tx(s.label)}」を見つけたよ！`)}else showToast(state.reading==='kana'?'この ひみつは みつけたよ！':'このひみつは見つけたよ！')}));
 updateHud();
}
function openMission(id){
 cleanupMiniGame();
 activeId=id; phase='intro';
 let d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id); let done=state.completed.includes(id);
 let photo=EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[id]?`<img class="missionDevicePreview" src="${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[id]}" alt="${dName(d)}の設備イラスト">`:``;
 const topTitle = `MISSION ${String(id).padStart(2,'0')} ／ ${dName(d)}`;
 const body = `<div class="challengeCard"><p class="challengeQuestion">${done ? (state.reading==='kana'?'もういちど ちょうせんできるよ！':'もう一度チャレンジできるよ！') : (state.reading==='kana'?'せつびの ひみつを みつけよう！':'設備のひみつを見つけよう！')}</p><p class="desc">${tx(d.desc)}</p>${photo}<p class="hint">${state.reading==='kana'?'したの ボタンで ミニゲーム スタート！':'下のボタンでミニゲームスタート！'}</p></div><div class="modalActions"><button class="mainBtn" id="startMission">${state.reading==='kana'?'ミッション スタート':'ミッションスタート'}</button></div>`;
 openModal('mission', topTitle, body);
 $('startMission').onclick=()=>beginMission();
}
function beginMission(){ let d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===activeId); phase='challenge'; sequenceIndex=0; tapCount=0; pairIndex=0; choices=shuffle(d.steps||[]); renderChallenge(); }
function renderChallenge(){
 cleanupMiniGame();
 let d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===activeId); let html=`<div class="challengeCard"><p class="challengeQuestion">${tx(d.question)}</p>`;
 if(d.type==='quiz'){ html+=`<div class="options">${d.options.map((v,i)=>`<button class="option" data-quiz="${i}">${tx(v)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`; }
 if(d.type==='sequence'){ html+=`<p class="stepProgress">${state.reading==='kana'?`${sequenceIndex+1} / ${d.steps.length} ばんめを えらんでね`:`${sequenceIndex+1} / ${d.steps.length} 番目を選んでね`}</p><div class="options">${choices.map((v,i)=>`<button class="option ${d.steps.indexOf(v)<sequenceIndex?'used':''}" data-seq="${i}" ${d.steps.indexOf(v)<sequenceIndex?'disabled':''}>${tx(v)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`; }
 if(d.type==='tap'){ html+=`<div class="bar"><div style="width:${Math.round(100*tapCount/d.target)}%"></div></div><p class="stepProgress">${tapCount} / ${d.target}</p><div class="center"><button class="tapButton" id="tapMission" aria-label="${tx(d.verb||'タップ')}">🍲</button></div><p class="hint center">${state.reading==='kana'?'できるだけ はやく れんだ！':'できるだけ速く連打！'}</p>`; }
 if(d.type==='pair'){ html+=`<p class="stepProgress">${pairIndex+1} / ${d.pairs.length}</p><p class="challengeQuestion" style="font-size:24px">${tx(d.pairs[pairIndex].q)}</p><div class="options">${d.choices.map((v,i)=>`<button class="option" data-pair="${i}">${tx(v)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`; }
 if(d.type==='timing'){ html+=`<div class="timingStage"><div class="timingBarWrap"><div class="timingZone"></div><div class="timingNeedle" id="timingNeedle"></div></div><div class="timingStatus" id="timingStatus">${state.reading==='kana'?'せいこう 0 / '+(d.needed||3):'成功 0 / '+(d.needed||3)}</div><div class="timingActions"><button class="mainBtn" id="timingTap">いま！</button></div></div>`; }
 if(d.type==='findbugs'){ html+=`<div class="findBugStage"><img class="findBugImage" src="${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[d.id]}" alt="${dName(d)}">${d.bugs.map((b,i)=>`<button class="bugSpot" data-bug="${i}" style="left:${b.x}%;top:${b.y}%" aria-label="虫を見つける">🐛</button>`).join('')}<div class="findBugCounter" id="bugCounter">0 / ${d.targetFound}</div></div>`; }
 html += `</div><div id="challengeFeedback" class="feedback" aria-live="polite"></div><div class="modalActions"><button class="altBtn" id="backIntro">${state.reading==='kana'?'せつめいへ もどる':'説明へ戻る'}</button></div>`;
 $('modalBody').innerHTML=html; syncModalFooter(); $('backIntro').onclick=()=>openMission(activeId);
 if(d.type==='quiz') document.querySelectorAll('[data-quiz]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{ if(+b.dataset.quiz===d.correct) winMission(); else wrong(state.reading==='kana'?'もういちど かんがえてみよう！':'もう一度考えてみよう！'); });
 if(d.type==='sequence') document.querySelectorAll('[data-seq]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{ if(choices[+b.dataset.seq]===d.steps[sequenceIndex]){ sequenceIndex++; if(sequenceIndex===d.steps.length) winMission(); else renderChallenge(); } else wrong(state.reading==='kana'?'じゅんばんが ちがうよ！':'順番がちがうよ！'); });
 if(d.type==='tap') $('tapMission').onclick=()=>{ tapCount++; if(tapCount>=d.target) winMission(); else renderChallenge(); };
 if(d.type==='pair') document.querySelectorAll('[data-pair]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{ if(d.choices[+b.dataset.pair]===d.pairs[pairIndex].a){ pairIndex++; if(pairIndex>=d.pairs.length) winMission(); else renderChallenge(); } else wrong(state.reading==='kana'?'ちがうみたい！':'ちがうみたい！'); });
 if(d.type==='timing') startTiming(d);
 if(d.type==='findbugs') startFindBugs(d);
}
function startTiming(d){
 timingState = {pos:0,dir:1,hits:0,needed:d.needed||3};
 const needle = $('timingNeedle'); const status = $('timingStatus');
 function tick(){
   if(!needle || !timingState) return;
   timingState.pos += timingState.dir*1.7;
   if(timingState.pos>=100 || timingState.pos<=0){ timingState.dir *= -1; timingState.pos = Math.max(0,Math.min(100,timingState.pos)); }
   needle.style.left = timingState.pos + '%';
   timingRAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 }
 tick();
 $('timingTap').onclick = ()=>{
   const hit = timingState.pos >= 42 && timingState.pos <= 58;
   if(hit){ timingState.hits++; status.textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? `せいこう ${timingState.hits} / ${timingState.needed}` : `成功 ${timingState.hits} / ${timingState.needed}`; $('challengeFeedback').textContent = 'ナイスタイミング！'; if(timingState.hits>=timingState.needed){ cleanupMiniGame(); winMission(); } }
   else { $('challengeFeedback').textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? 'タイミングが ずれた！ もういちど！' : 'タイミングがずれた！ もう一度！'; }
 };
}
function startFindBugs(d){
 bugState = {found:0,target:d.targetFound||3};
 document.querySelectorAll('.bugSpot').forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>{ if(btn.classList.contains('found')) return; btn.classList.add('found'); bugState.found++; $('bugCounter').textContent = `${bugState.found} / ${bugState.target}`; if(bugState.found>=bugState.target) winMission(); });
}
function wrong(t){ $('challengeFeedback').textContent=t; showToast(state.reading==='kana'?'ヒントを みて もういちど！':'ヒントを見てもう一度！'); }
function launchCardCapture(d){
 const host=$('cardCaptureOverlay');
 host.innerHTML=`<div class="cardCaptureStage"><div class="cardCaptureGlow"></div><div class="cardCaptureLabel">★ STAR CARD GET!</div><div class="cardCaptureFront">${starCardArt(d)}</div><div class="cardCaptureFile"></div></div>`;
 host.classList.remove('collected'); host.classList.add('visible');
 clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer); clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer2);
 window._cardEffectTimer=setTimeout(()=>host.classList.add('collected'),900);
 window._cardEffectTimer2=setTimeout(()=>{host.classList.remove('visible','collected');host.replaceChildren();},2100);
}
function buildStarPocket(index){
 let d = DEVICES[index];
 if(d){
  const got = state.completed.includes(d.id);
  if(!got) return `<div class="starPocket cardLocked" aria-label="No.${String(d.id).padStart(2,'0')} 未獲得"><span class="starLock">★</span><span class="starNumber">No.${String(d.id).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span class="starEmptyLabel">${state.reading==='kana'?'みはっけん':'未獲得'}</span></div>`;
  return `<button type="button" class="starPocket cardUnlocked ${recentStarId===d.id?'justCollected':''}" data-star-card="${d.id}" aria-label="スターカードを見る"><span class="starCardFace"><span class="starCardVisual">${starCardArt(d)}</span></span></button>`;
 }
 const char = CHARS[index-DEVICES.length] || CHARS[0];
 return `<div class="starPocket cardEmptyCharacter"><img src="${ASSETS[char.id]}" alt="${char.name}"><strong>${char.name}</strong><span>ボーナスポケット</span></div>`;
}
function starFilePages(){ return `<section class="starSleevePage" aria-label="カードファイル"><div class="starPageLabel">★ STAR CARD FILE</div><div class="starPocketGrid">${Array.from({length:12},(_,j)=>buildStarPocket(j)).join('')}</div></section>`; }
function openGuide(){
 dismissCardCapture();
 const collected = state.completed.length;
 openModal('guide', `カードファイル　${collected} / 12`, `<div class="starAlbum"><div class="starAlbumBar"><div class="starMeter"><b>★ ${collected} / 12 枚</b><span class="starBar" aria-hidden="true"><i style="width:${collected/12*100}%"></i></span></div><span class="langBadge">${state.reading==='kana'?'カードを タップで おおきく ひょうじ':'カードをタップで大きく表示'}</span></div><div class="starBinder"><div class="starSpread" id="starSpread">${starFilePages()}</div><div class="starPreview" id="starPreview" aria-live="polite"></div></div><div class="starBottomBar"><span>✨ ひみつ ${state.secrets.length} / 4</span><span>4×3 ポケット</span></div></div><div class="modalActions"><button type="button" class="altBtn" id="guideClose">${state.reading==='kana'?'マップへ もどる':'マップへ戻る'}</button></div>`);

function showStarDetail(id){

function openHelp(){ openModal('help', state.reading==='kana'?'あそびかた':'遊び方', `<div class="challengeCard"><p class="challengeQuestion">${state.reading==='kana'?'きゅうしょくしつを たんけんしよう！':'給食室を探検しよう！'}</p><p class="desc" style="text-align:left">${state.reading==='kana'?'① せつびを タップして ミニゲームに ちょうせん<br>② クリアすると カードが ふえる<br>③ かくされた ひみつも みつけてみよう<br>④ したの ボタンで ぜんたいひょうじ・ほぞん・もどる を つかえるよ':'① 設備をタップしてミニゲームに挑戦<br>② クリアするとカードが増える<br>③ 隠されたひみつも見つけてみよう<br>④ 下のボタンで全体表示・保存・戻るが使えるよ'}</p></div><div class="challengeCard"><p class="challengeQuestion">クイズについて</p><p class="desc">${state.reading==='kana'?'がっこうきゅうしょくえいせいかんりきじゅん や ちょうりししけん に ちなんだ もんだいが でるよ。':'学校給食衛生管理基準や調理師試験にちなんだ問題が出るよ。'}</p></div><button class="altBtn" id="helpClose">OK</button>`); $('helpClose').onclick=closeModal; }
const SANITARY_ROOMS_V22=[
 {id:'entry',title:'前室',kind:'その他の区域',desc:'着替えや手洗いなど、作業に入る前の準備をする場所です。',className:'other'},

let launchBusy=false,launchTimers=[];

function enterLaunch(){ let c=CHARS.find(x=>x.id===state.character)||CHARS[0]; $('launchBuddy').src=ASSETS[c.id]; $('launchBuddyName').textContent=c.name; launchBusy=false; $('launchCountdown').classList.remove('active'); showScreen('launch'); applyReadingMode(); }
function beginLaunch(){ if(launchBusy) return; launchBusy=true; launchTimers.forEach(clearTimeout); launchTimers=[]; const overlay=$('launchCountdown'),label=$('countdownText'); overlay.classList.add('active'); overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); const seq=['3','2','1','GO!']; seq.forEach((v,i)=>launchTimers.push(setTimeout(()=>{ label.textContent=v; label.classList.remove('tick'); void label.offsetWidth; label.classList.add('tick'); }, i*340))); launchTimers.push(setTimeout(()=>{ overlay.classList.remove('active'); overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); save(); hasSave=true; showScreen('play'); launchBusy=false; applyReadingMode(); showToast(state.reading==='kana'?'4つの ひみつを みつけよう！':'4つの秘密を見つけよう！'); },1450)); }

 $('continueGame').disabled=!hasSave;

 if($('continueGame')) $('continueGame').textContent = 'つづきから';

 if($('launchStart')) $('launchStart').textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? 'たんけん スタート！' : '探検スタート！';
 if($('launchBack')) $('launchBack').textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? 'キャラを えらびなおす' : 'キャラを選びなおす';
}

'漢字に切替' : 'ひらがなに切替'; if($('returnTitle')) $('returnTitle').textContent = state.reading==='kana' ? 'タイトルへ もどる' : 'タイトルに戻る'; }

/* Ver.2.5: one-screen play, existing artwork, 4 cards per single-sided page. */
const V25_BOOK_PAGES = 4;
let v25Page=1;
let v25Turning=false;
const v25Completed=()=>state.completed.length===12;
function v25BookPocket(n){
  const d=DEVICES[n];
  if(!d) return `<div class="v25-pocket v25-empty" aria-label="空のポケット"><span>空きポケット</span></div>`;
  const got=state.completed.includes(d.id);
  if(!got) return `<div class="v25-pocket v25-locked"><b>No.${String(d.id).padStart(2,'0')}</b><span>未獲得</span></div>`;
  return `<button type="button" class="v25-pocket v25-collected" data-v25-card="${d.id}" aria-label="${dName(d)}のカードを大きく表示">${starCardArt(d)}</button>`;
}
function v25PageContents(n){
  const count=state.completed.length;
  const left=`<div class="v25-book-left"><p class="v25-book-kicker">FUJINOE STAR CARD FILE</p><h3>給食室のひみつ</h3><p class="v25-book-description">見つけた設備のカードを<br>1枚ずつ集めよう。</p><div class="v25-book-counter"><strong>${count} <small>/ 12</small></strong><span>COLLECTED</span></div><p class="v25-book-pageno">PAGE ${n} / ${V25_BOOK_PAGES}</p></div>`;
  if(n===4){
    const charGroup=['shiro','fox','fu','piyo'].map(id=>{let c=CHARS.find(x=>x.id===id); return `<img src="${ASSETS[id]}" alt="${c.name}" loading="lazy">`}).join('');
    return `${left}<div class="v25-book-right v25-congrats"><div class="v25-complete-burst">${v25Completed()?'<span class="v25-complete-tag">COMPLETE!</span><h3>コンプリート！</h3>':'<h3>最後のページ</h3>'}<div class="v25-character-group">${v25Completed()?charGroup:'<p>12枚すべて集めると<br>4人の仲間が登場するよ！</p>'}</div><p>${v25Completed()?'これで君は給食室マスター！':'もうすぐコンプリート！'}</p></div></div>`;
  }
  return `${left}<div class="v25-book-right"><div class="v25-page-cards">${Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>v25BookPocket((n-1)*4+i)).join('')}</div></div>`;
}
function v25RenderPage(){
 const book=$('v25-book'); if(!book)return;
 book.classList.remove('v25-turning');
 book.innerHTML=v25PageContents(v25Page);
 $('v25-page-index').textContent=`${v25Page} / ${V25_BOOK_PAGES}`;
 $('v25-prev').disabled=v25Page===1;
 $('v25-next').disabled=v25Page===V25_BOOK_PAGES || (v25Page===3 && !v25Completed());
 // page 4 becomes available when all twelve cards have been collected.
 const pageLinks=document.querySelectorAll('[data-v25-page]');
 pageLinks.forEach(b=>{let p=Number(b.dataset.v25Page);b.classList.toggle('selected',p===v25Page);b.disabled=p===4&&!v25Completed();});
 book.querySelectorAll('[data-v25-card]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>showStarDetail(Number(b.dataset.v25Card)));
}
function v25GoPage(n){
 if(v25Turning||n<1||n>V25_BOOK_PAGES || (n===4&&!v25Completed()))return;
 if(n===v25Page)return;
 v25Turning=true;
 const book=$('v25-book'); if(book)book.classList.add('v25-turning');
 setTimeout(()=>{v25Page=n;v25RenderPage();v25Turning=false;},210);
}
function openGuide(page){
 dismissCardCapture();
 v25Page=Math.min(V25_BOOK_PAGES, Math.max(1,typeof page==='number' ? page : (v25Completed()?4:1)));
 if(!v25Completed() && v25Page===4)v25Page=3;
 const heading=state.reading==='kana'?'カードファイル':'カードファイル';
 const footer=`<div class="v25-book-navigation" aria-label="ページ切り替え"><button id="v25-prev" aria-label="前のページ">前へ</button><div class="v25-page-tabs">${Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>`<button type="button" data-v25-page="${i+1}">${i+1}</button>`).join('')}</div><strong id="v25-page-index">1 / 4</strong><button id="v25-next" aria-label="次のページ">次へ</button></div><p class="v25-book-hint">カードをタップすると大きく表示できます。4ページ目は12枚獲得で解放されます。</p>`;
 openModal('guide',`${heading}　${state.completed.length} / 12`, `<div class="v25-album"><div class="v25-book" id="v25-book" role="region" aria-label="カードファイルのページ"></div><div class="v25-star-preview" id="starPreview" aria-live="polite"></div>${footer}</div>`);
 $('v25-prev').onclick=()=>v25GoPage(v25Page-1);
 $('v25-next').onclick=()=>v25GoPage(v25Page+1);
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-v25-page]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>v25GoPage(Number(b.dataset.v25Page)));
 v25RenderPage();
}
function showStarDetail(id){
 const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id);
 if(!d || !state.completed.includes(id)) return;
 const overlay=$('starPreview');
 if(!overlay)return;
 overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="v25-detail-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="スターカードの拡大表示"><p>STAR CARD No.${String(d.id).padStart(2,'0')}</p>${starCardArt(d)}<h3>${dName(d)}</h3><p>${tx(d.desc)}</p><button type="button" id="v25-detail-close">ファイルへ戻る</button></div>`;
 overlay.classList.add('active');
 $('v25-detail-close').onclick=()=>{overlay.classList.remove('active');overlay.replaceChildren();};
 $('v25-detail-close').focus();
}
// Hide the redundant briefing and start the game straight after character selection.

 ensureChar();
 save();hasSave=true;
 showScreen('play');applyReadingMode();
 showToast(state.reading==='kana'?'せつびを タップして ひみつを みつけよう！':'設備をタップして秘密を見つけよう！');
}
// Keep the original game completion animation and offer the bonus page straight away.

 v25PreviousEnding();
 const endGuide=$('endGuide');if(endGuide)endGuide.onclick=()=>openGuide(4);

for(const [id,label] of Object.entries({rechoose:'キャラ変更',zonesGuide:'部屋の区分',mapHelp:'遊び方'})){
 const b=$(id);if(b)b.textContent=label;

// The normal per-character form is retained; no extra briefing between it and play.

/* FUJINOE KITCHEN ADVENTURE Ver.2.8 — responsive interactive room map and skill games */
Object.assign(DEVICES[5],{type:'sequence',question:'ごはんを炊く順番をタップしよう！'});
const V26_ROOMS = [
 {key:'front', name:'前室', kind:'その他の区域', style:'front', ids:[1], secret:0},
 {key:'prep', name:'下処理室', kind:'汚染作業区域', style:'prep', ids:[2,11], secret:1},
 {key:'storage', name:'食品保管室',kind:'汚染作業区域',style:'storage',ids:[3],secret:0},
 {key:'cut', name:'調理室・切裁',kind:'非汚染作業区域',style:'cut',ids:[4],secret:0},
 {key:'cook', name:'調理室',kind:'非汚染作業区域',style:'cook',ids:[5,6,7,8,12],secret:4},
 {key:'wash',name:'洗浄室',kind:'使用に応じて区分',style:'wash',ids:[9],secret:2},
 {key:'clean',name:'洗浄後・保管',kind:'非汚染作業区域',style:'clean',ids:[10],secret:3}
];
const v26Kanji=(kanji,kana)=>state.reading==='kana'?kana:kanji;
const v26E=(value)=>String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g,s=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[s]));
function v26Device(id){const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id); const done=state.completed.includes(id); const names=['','手洗いシンク','三層シンク','パススルー冷蔵庫','スライサー','IHヒーター','炊飯器','スチコン','回転釜','食器洗浄機','消毒保管庫','ピーラー','ミキサー'];
 return `<button type="button" class="v26-device ${done?'is-done':''}" data-v26-device="${id}" aria-label="${v26E(d.name)}：ミッションに挑戦"><span class="v26-number">${String(id).padStart(2,'0')}</span><img alt="${v26E(d.name)}" src="${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[id]}" loading="lazy"><strong>${v26E(v26Kanji(names[id],tx(names[id])))}</strong>${done?'<span class="v26-check" aria-label="クリア済み">✓</span>':''}</button>`;}
function v26Room(room){return `<section class="v26-room v26-${room.style}" aria-label="${v26E(room.name)}"><div class="v26-room-head"><h2>${v26E(v26Kanji(room.name,tx(room.name)))}</h2><small>${v26E(v26Kanji(room.kind,tx(room.kind)))}</small></div><div class="v26-devices v26-device-count-${room.ids.length}">${room.ids.map(v26Device).join('')}</div>${room.secret?`<button type="button" class="v26-secret ${state.secrets.includes(room.secret)?'found':''}" data-v26-secret="${room.secret}"><span class="v31-tome-art" aria-hidden="true"><img src="${V31_SECRET_BOOK_IMAGE}" alt=""><span class="v31-book-mark">秘</span></span><span class="v31-tome-label">${v26Kanji('秘密','ひみつ')}</span>${state.secrets.includes(room.secret)?'<span class="v31-tome-done" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>':''}</button>`:''}</section>`}
